items.title: E&P stocks outlook: valuations, cash flow, and the OPEC+ wildcard
items.summary: Investing.com -- The E&P group has had a strong year, but the commodity backdrop is softening. Crude Oil WTI trades at $83.54 (Nov 19, 9:24 AM EST). That is down 15.2% over 1M and up 40.6% over 1Y. Brent Oil is at $93.09, 12.2% below its level a month ago. The 52-week WTI range is $54.98–$117.63. Equities are pricing something close to today’s strip rather than a spike.

items.title: The 5 Best Stocks in Berkshire Hathaway’s Portfolio
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBerkshire Hathaway’s latest 13F shows that, among its positions of 2% or more, analysts see the most upside in Alphabet, Bank of America, Occidental Petroleum and American Express. Analysts’ average targets sit 43% to 44% above Alphabet’s two share classes, 26% above Bank of America and Occidental, and 16% above American Express.
